name: Metabase
description: Open source business intelligence and analytics platform. Create dashboards and explore data without writing SQL.
summary: Metabase is actively releasing patch updates across multiple supported branches simultaneously. The latest release is v0.62.3 (Open Source) / v1.62.3 (Enterprise), published on 24 June 2025, alongside concurrent patches for branches 58, 59, 60, and 61. Both Open Source and Enterprise editions are available as Docker images and JAR downloads. Detailed changelogs per release are linked from the GitHub releases page at https://github.com/metabase/metabase/releases.

answers.What is the current license?: Open Source edition uses AGPL v3; Enterprise edition uses a commercial license (Metabase Commercial Software License).
answers.Is the project actively maintained?: Yes — multiple patch releases across several branches were published on 24 June 2025 alone.
answers.Is there a cloud-hosted version availabl: Yes — Metabase offers a managed cloud (Metabase Cloud) at https://www.metabase.com.
answers.Does it support SSO and SAML authenticat: Yes — SSO and SAML are supported in the Enterprise edition.
answers.What databases/data sources are supporte: Supports many sources including PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, Oracle, SQLite, MongoDB, Presto, Druid, SparkSQL, and more (full list varies by edition).

alternatives.name: Redash
alternatives.review: Open source, query-focused, simpler feature set.

alternatives.name: Apache Superset
alternatives.review: Apache-licensed, rich visualisation library, steeper setup curve.

alternatives.name: Grafana
alternatives.review: Primarily metrics/time-series but increasingly used for general BI.

alternatives.name: Hex
alternatives.review: Close source, enterprise focus, AI Analytics Platform for your whole team

alternatives.name: Tableau
alternatives.review: Offers far richer visualizations and enterprise features than Metabase but comes at a significantly higher cost with no open-source option.

alternatives.name: Looker (Google)
alternatives.review: Provides a more robust semantic modeling layer and enterprise governance than Metabase, but is cloud-only, proprietary, and considerably more expensive.
